comment: invent.c getobj() with force_invmenu. Each forced menu passes display_pickinv() the menu query "What do you want to <word>?", which end_menu() shows above the candidates. The hero opens the eat menu and escapes it, opens the wield menu, picks '*' to redisplay it with the whole inventory and escapes, then opens the throw menu and escapes. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
